verdict.rationale: Treg is built to be driven by an AI agent in natural language. You can bootstrap it with a single prompt ("set up treg - https://treg.to/llms.txt"), and it ships an official MCP endpoint and Claude connector exposing operations like balance and review. Documented workflows return lead lists, creator lists or ad intel from "one prompt", and catalog search works by intent rather than vendor. Missing for 10: no native natural-language interface (it depends on an external agent such as Claude), no evidence that team or admin operations like member tool permissions can be done in natural language, and no hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
